name: @filament/filament-openclaw
description: OpenClaw plugin that connects an agent to Filament via a poll_work long-poll and the Filament MCP-over-HTTP agents API.

scripts.build: esbuild index.ts src/util.ts src/accounts.ts src/gateway.ts src/state/store.ts src/state/identities.ts src/state/bearers.ts src/state/updates.ts src/state/sign-in.ts src/state/hello.ts src/state/poll-cursors.ts src/state/pending-replies.ts src/state/in-flight.ts src/mcp-client.ts src/settings.ts src/credentials.ts src/connect.ts src/work-item.ts src/wake-rules.ts src/accept-pending.ts src/config-write.ts src/oauth-login.ts src/sign-in.ts src/login-cli.ts src/hello.ts src/commands.ts src/profile-seed.ts src/room-labels.ts src/version.ts src/update-check.ts src/transports/types.ts src/transports/poll/index.ts src/transports/poll/poll-work.ts src/media.ts src/outbound.ts src/onboarding-core.ts src/filament-tools.ts src/channel.ts src/turn.ts src/failure-note.ts src/silent-reply-policy.ts src/retired-settings.ts --outdir=dist --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/filament-tools.snapshot.json','dist/src/filament-tools.snapshot.json')"
scripts.test: esbuild src/onboarding-core.test.ts src/mcp-client.test.ts src/credentials.test.ts src/connect.test.ts src/settings.test.ts src/transports/poll/poll-work.test.ts src/transports/poll/index.test.ts src/filament-tools.test.ts src/accounts.test.ts src/gateway.test.ts src/config-write.test.ts src/oauth-login.test.ts src/sign-in.test.ts src/login-cli.test.ts src/hello.test.ts src/commands.test.ts src/profile-seed.test.ts src/turn.test.ts src/failure-note.test.ts src/silent-reply-policy.test.ts src/retired-settings.test.ts src/room-labels.test.ts src/version.test.ts src/update-check.test.ts src/state/store.test.ts src/media.test.ts src/outbound.test.ts --bundle --external:openclaw --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=dist-test --out-extension:.js=.mjs && node --test dist-test/onboarding-core.test.mjs dist-test/mcp-client.test.mjs dist-test/credentials.test.mjs dist-test/connect.test.mjs dist-test/settings.test.mjs dist-test/transports/poll/poll-work.test.mjs dist-test/transports/poll/index.test.mjs dist-test/filament-tools.test.mjs dist-test/accounts.test.mjs dist-test/gateway.test.mjs dist-test/config-write.test.mjs dist-test/oauth-login.test.mjs dist-test/sign-in.test.mjs dist-test/login-cli.test.mjs dist-test/hello.test.mjs dist-test/commands.test.mjs dist-test/profile-seed.test.mjs dist-test/turn.test.mjs dist-test/failure-note.test.mjs dist-test/silent-reply-policy.test.mjs dist-test/retired-settings.test.mjs dist-test/room-labels.test.mjs dist-test/version.test.mjs dist-test/update-check.test.mjs dist-test/state/store.test.mjs dist-test/media.test.mjs dist-test/outbound.test.mjs
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && npm run build && git add openclaw.plugin.json src/version.ts dist
